extracted.name: Guacamole
extracted.description: Recipe video above. A really great Guacamole, the way it's made in Mexico and in the best Mexican restaurants around the world! The secret step that makes this so special is making a paste with onion, chilli, coriander/cilantro and salt before adding the avocado. Mashing is key to release flavour. And nobody wants raw onion chunks in their guac!
ingredient_lines: 2 tbsp finely chopped white onion ((or red, brown or yellow))
1 tbsp finely chopped jalapeno or serrano chilli ((or other chilli of choice) (adjust to taste))
1/2 tsp salt (, plus more to taste)
Lime juice (, to taste (I use 1/4 - 1/2 lime))
Optional: 1 ripe tomato (, peeled, deseeded and chopped)
instruction_lines: Place the onion, jalapeño, salt and half the coriander on a cutting board and use a fork to mash until juicy. OR do this in a mortar and pestle - grind into a paste.
Scrape into a bowl, add avocado and remaining coriander, and mash to desired consistency.
Do a taste test then adjust to your taste: salt, lime juice for sour, more chilli for spiciness.
